verdict.rationale: Grafana's core source code is hosted publicly on GitHub (grafana-gh-1..6) and community discussion explicitly confirms it is licensed under AGPLv3 (grafana-comm-9, grafana-comm-10), an OSI-approved open license, satisfying the ability to read the source under an open license. Missing for 10: explicit first-party license-file citation and clarity on which enterprise-only modules are excluded from the open license.
